root_cause: RND-0041 boundary proof compared raw UTC timestamp strings rather than parsed UTC instants. Fractional-second provider timestamps can compare incorrectly against second-resolution boundary strings even when they represent valid in-range instants.
remediation: Compare parsed UTC instants in RND-0041 boundary proof and regression-test fractional-second provider timestamp formatting. Preserve failed output root separately; do not treat it as sealed or resumable validation evidence.
